Title: uTPro AdProtect
Description: Invalid-click protection and ad-serving control for Umbraco sites monetized with Google AdSense (or any ad network). Decides per visitor whether ad code is served: blocks bots/scanners via IP/CIDR/country/ASN rules, counts ad-click intent per IP and per anonymous cookie, auto-cools down repeat clickers, with a full backoffice dashboard. Cache-safe, CGNAT-aware, optional hashed-IP storage.
